POST remains append-right and does not invoke remapping, while metadata-only and rename PATCHes use the status-neutral path; the edge suite verifies existing card status/version and activity preservation (server/src/routes/columns.ts:64-83, 300-331; server/src/routes/columns-is-done-remap.edge.test.ts:103-168).
